The main takeaway from our work is that
by leveraging human demonstrations to discretize the action space, we can solve challenging continuous control problems in an efficient and effective way.
by quantizing the actions we can leverage the priors from demonstrations and improve the performance of the learned policy, while at the same time reducing the exploration problem.
the discretization of action spaces can help to solve complex continuous control problems, even in the absence of any expert supervision.
